summary: TransDigm Group filed an 8-K to announce its withdrawal from the proposed acquisition of Stellant Systems from Arlington Capital Partners. The decision was made after concluding that continuing the regulatory review was not in the best interests of shareholders due to uncertainty, time constraints, and opportunity costs. TransDigm withdrew its regulatory filing on July 10, 2026, and the seller terminated the agreement. No financial terms, premium, or break fee are disclosed. The company reaffirmed its commitment to a disciplined acquisition strategy. Watch for potential deal-related litigation or break-fee disputes.
